title: Indentation marks the guarded step
idea: The spaces in front of a line (indentation) tell Python which steps belong to the if. This is how Python groups the guarded work.

exercises.prompt: How does Python know which step belongs to the if?
options: It is indented (spaces in front) under the if line
It is on the same line
It comes first in the file
exercises.explanation: The indented line under the if is the guarded step. Indentation is how Python groups it.

exercises.prompt:
What does this print?

if True:
    print("A")
print("B")
exercises.explanation: print("A") is guarded and runs (condition True). print("B") is NOT indented, so it always runs. Both print.

exercises.prompt:
What does this print?

if False:
    print("A")
print("B")
exercises.explanation: print("A") is guarded by a False condition, so it is skipped. print("B") is not indented, so it still runs.

exercises.prompt: A line that is NOT indented under the if runs no matter what.
exercises.explanation: Yes - only indented lines are guarded. Unindented lines run regardless of the condition.

exercises.prompt:
What does this print?

if True:
    print("one")
    print("two")
exercises.explanation: Both indented lines are guarded by the same True condition, so both run.

exercises.prompt:
What does this print?

if False:
    print("one")
    print("two")
exercises.explanation: Both lines are indented under a False condition, so both are skipped. Nothing prints.

exercises.prompt:
Which print is GUARDED by the if?

if True:
    print("inside")
print("outside")
exercises.explanation: Only the indented print("inside") is guarded. The unindented print("outside") always runs.

exercises.prompt: Arrange so a greeting is guarded by the if, and a goodbye always runs after.
exercises.explanation: if line first, then the indented guarded step, then the unindented line that always runs.
The guarded print runs only when happy is True. A False condition skips it.

exercises.prompt: Why does indentation matter so much in Python?
options: It decides which steps are inside the if and which are outside
exercises.explanation: Indentation is not just style in Python - it literally groups the guarded steps. Getting it wrong changes what runs.
